name: doca-public-knowledge-map
description: Use this skill to locate authoritative NVIDIA DOCA information without the source tree: the docs.nvidia.com page for a library/service/tool, which DOCA libraries are installed and at what version, a sample on disk or GitHub, a path under /opt/mellanox/doca, or a 404'd/renamed doc URL. Activate on implicit phrasing only when the conversation already names DOCA, BlueField, ConnectX, or /opt/mellanox. Do not activate for generic 'which version is installed' or 'where is the sample' questions with none of that context. Refuse and route elsewhere for hands-on programming, env prep, API tutorials, or hardware/firmware mutation — those belong to doca-programming-guide, doca-setup, the per-library skills, and doca-hardware-safety.
